parts.text: I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order, which involves adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, and setting up charging pads at our sites. I also take drones out of service for repairs and put them back when they are ready, and I send drones to charge. Regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after, and our repairs and servicing are carried out by technicians like me.
